steps.title: 先看全貌
steps.text: 24篇访谈，按业务问题整理成五个分支。每个分支都在回答一个现实问题。

steps.title: 从一个分支进入
steps.text: 流程自动化这五个案例，关注同一件事：怎样减少重复工作，并保留人的判断。

steps.title: 原来，卡在哪里？
steps.text: 以车管所为例：工作人员要逐张看材料，再读信息、填单、搬运数据。

steps.title: 先分清任务
steps.text: 识别图片、抽取文本、操作系统，是不同的任务，需要不同工具配合。

steps.title: 再面对真实数据
steps.text: 复印件、小字、不完整照片，都要进入测试。识别能力是在真实样本中磨出来的。

steps.title: 让流程真正跑下去
steps.text: 识别以后，还要自动填单并流转到原有系统。异常情况留给工作人员。

steps.title: 看结果，也看口径
steps.text: 项目反馈每单审核从约15分钟缩短到3—5分钟，指这一项目的全流程审核。

steps.title: 最后，划清边界
steps.text: 审核规则的宽严由业务负责人决定。一次项目的成果，不等于其他场景的收益承诺。

steps.title: Start with the big picture
steps.text: Twenty-four interviews form five branches, each organized around a real business problem.

steps.title: Explore one branch
steps.text: These five automation cases share a goal: reduce repetitive work while keeping human judgment.

steps.title: Find the bottleneck
steps.text: At a vehicle registration office, staff reviewed each document, then read, entered, and transferred the data.

steps.title: Separate the tasks
steps.text: Image recognition, text extraction, and operating software are different tasks. Each needs the right tools.

steps.title: Test with real documents
steps.text: Photocopies, tiny text, and incomplete photos all belong in testing. Real samples help improve recognition.

steps.title: Complete the workflow
steps.text: After recognition, forms are filled and data moves into existing systems. Staff handle exceptions.

steps.title: Read results in context
steps.text: The project reported cutting each full review from about fifteen minutes to three to five minutes.

steps.title: Keep the boundaries clear
steps.text: The business owner decides how strict review rules should be. One project’s results do not guarantee benefits elsewhere.
